title: Co-Scientist and ALS: hypotheses about RNA-based mechanisms
summary: Two groups, at MIT (Ritu Raman) and Boston Children's Hospital (Ryan Flynn), used Co-Scientist to assess a conflicting literature, turn ideas into testable hypotheses, and rank them by feasibility, focusing on RNA-based mechanisms and drugs. The post reports no quantitative results or experimental validation; the research is ongoing.
organization: Google DeepMind, MIT, and Boston Children's Hospital
